'''District 36''' was the thirty-sixth level of the [[City/Legends|city]] known as the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]<ref name="Firebrand" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=kotfe|Zakuul}}</ref> Like all of the other districts, or levels, of the Spire, District 36 was labyrinthian in design and boasted a variety of [[Museum/Legends|museums]], [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], and other entertainment venues; all of the districts were constructed with identical living conditions to each other per the orders of the [[Emperor/Legends|Immortal Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]].<ref name="Spire">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=kotfe|The Spire}}</ref>

In [[3632 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.1}} During Chapter X, [[SCORPIO]] states that [[Kaliyo Djannis]] arrived at the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] two years prior, placing her arrival in [[3632 BBY]].</ref> the newly-arrived anarchist [[Kaliyo Djannis]] bombed the [[District 36 Museum of Art]] in a very public act of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], an act that earned her the alias "Firebrand" and a reputation as a dangerous and fashionable terrorist.<ref name="Firebrand" />

==Behind the scenes==
District 36 was mentioned in the Codex entry for "Firebrand"<ref name="Firebrand" /> in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The entry was added to the game as part of Update 4.1 in [[2016]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|4.1}}</ref>
